name: JoAi: Delete Order

description.en: Permanently delete an order or quote. Use with care — this cannot be undone.
description.de: Eine Bestellung oder ein Angebot dauerhaft löschen. Vorsicht — dies kann nicht rückgängig gemacht werden.
description.fr: Supprimer définitivement une commande ou un devis. À utiliser avec précaution — irréversible.
description.es: Elimina permanentemente un pedido u oferta. Úsalo con cuidado: no se puede deshacer.
description.it: Elimina definitivamente un ordine o un'offerta. Da usare con cautela — non reversibile.
description.ro: Șterge definitiv o comandă sau o ofertă. Folosește cu atenție — nu poate fi anulată.

bot: Use when the user wants to remove an order or quote. If the user refers to an order by customer or item, list orders first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Order ID

description.en: The hashid of the order to delete
description.de: Die Hashid der zu löschenden Bestellung
description.fr: Le hashid de la commande à supprimer
description.es: El hashid del pedido a eliminar

inputs.bot: The order hash ID. If the user refers to an order by customer or item, list orders first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug of the order. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug der Bestellung. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.fr: Slug d'équipe de la commande. Par défaut l'équipe actuelle.
description.es: Slug del equipo del pedido. Por defecto el equipo actual.
description.it: Slug del team dell'ordine. Predefinito: team attuale.
description.ro: Slug-ul echipei comenzii. Implicit echipa curentă.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team the order belongs to. Omit to use the current team.
